search_knowledge.title: Past incident: astronomy-db — no fault flag
search_knowledge.text: product-catalog's connection pool to astronomy-db was sized for steady-state traffic; a routine traffic ramp from the load generator exceeded it, and requests queued for a free connection instead of failing fast. No fault flag was active. Signature: pg_stat_activity_count pinned at the configured max; product-catalog duration_p95 up; astronomy-db itself shows no errors, only saturation.

query_prometheus.expr: error ratio / duration for product-catalog and its dependencies
